title: fslmerge
description: FSL tool to concatenate images in various dimensions

merge_x.description: Concatenate images in the x direction
merge_x.title: Merge in X Direction

merge_y.description: Concatenate images in the y direction
merge_y.title: Merge in Y Direction

merge_z.description: Concatenate images in the z direction
merge_z.title: Merge in Z Direction

auto_choose.description: Auto-choose: single slices -> volume, volumes -> 4D (time series)
auto_choose.title: Auto-choose Merge

merge_set_tr.description: Concatenate images in time and set the output image tr to the provided value
merge_set_tr.title: Merge in Time with TR

volume_number.description: Only use volume <N> from each input file (first volume is 0 not 1)
volume_number.title: Volume Number

tr_value.description: TR value in seconds, used with the -tr flag
tr_value.title: TR Value
